scope.selection: one explicit direct map or one tile of that map
scope.source_owner: AvailableSelectedPackage retaining AvailableSelectedPlan and section coverage

admission.parent_closure: only selected map and its actual effective-parent chain; copies never supply direct rows or parents
admission.filesystem: actual rooted map and vmap inventories are required for the selected map and every active ancestor
admission.empty_terrain: a present, valid empty tilelist is authoritative; missing or malformed lookup fails closed
admission.mutable_inputs: rooted no-follow identities are checked at admission and run boundaries; detected mutation latches the owner
admission.selection_failures: unknown, copy-only, All, and out-of-owner map/tile selections reject before runtime input reads or callbacks
admission.liquid_types: caller must provide complete build-70450 LiquidTypes; selected map coverage cannot establish completeness

bounded_execution.metadata_calls: cumulative across admission, verification, and one run; each stage receives only its remaining allowance
bounded_execution.planning_work: cumulative deterministic closure and Plan charges, plus separately counted rooted metadata calls; discovery entries, descriptors, and tilelist bytes retain independent ceilings
bounded_execution.builder_save_work: cumulative builder.work and save.work counters within one run; remaining allowance is applied to each tile call before pipeline execution
bounded_execution.other_pipeline_work: existing per-tile stage ceilings remain; bounded by at most 4096 selected tiles, not represented as a universal measured work sum
bounded_execution.heap: retained rooted owner and plan plus at most one fresh pipeline tile context; provider and static-store ceilings remain separately enforced; no total RSS claim
bounded_execution.failure: a failed run latches the owner; no retry or budget reset is admitted

preserved_interfaces.complete_filesystem_package: inventory::fs::Package and inventory::fs::run::execute keep their existing complete-source API
preserved_interfaces.partial_plan: available owner exposes AvailableSelectedPlan only and has no conversion or accessor to complete Plan
preserved_interfaces.distribution: no CLI, dependency, or distribution recipe change

counter_coverage_gaps: availability-source decoding is bounded and reported by its existing reader before this filesystem owner receives AvailableRecords
directory iteration, path parsing, and sorting have entry/name/descriptor ceilings but are not reported as one universal work counter
synthetic_validation_requirements: selected last-direct-ID-wins closure and real ancestor inventories
unknown and copy-only selection reject before rooted filesystem access
missing, malformed, empty, and symlink inventory distinctions fail closed
mutation and metadata, descriptor, heap, planning-work, output, and per-run stage limits
typed selected runner rejects All and invalid selection before reads or callbacks
sink failure and final verification failure retain provisional callback semantics and latch the owner
complete Package and execute path remain available
non_claims: no MMapManager acquisition, legacy container reader, filename-manager, or filesystem parity claim
no complete-source or full-world coverage claim
no off-mesh-source completeness or LiquidTypes completeness claim
no native Detour parity, RustyCore runtime, server build admission, or release acceptance claim
no Windows filesystem support or Windows runtime acceptance claim
no universal aggregate execution-work or process RSS measurement claim
